payload.title: Android client observation tier: observable stores + Compose query + session (parity with FR-135)
payload.description: Android/Kotlin parity with the Swift observation tier (FR-135). FrickSwift is getting a reactive layer over the transport (observable object cache + sync loop, @FrickQuery, observable session manager, sharing service). Android currently exposes only the FrickSyncSocket transport + flows. Bring Compose/Kotlin idiomatic equivalents so Android apps get the same ergonomics as SwiftUI/web. Use StateFlow/Flow + collectAsState, not custom observation.
